text:
incident-bot: paging maria — High error rate on /v1/generate (us-west-2). 70% 5xx, automated rollback threshold hit. https://monitoring.redwood.example/alerts/6532109999
maria (oncall): acked, joining. oncall runbook: https://wiki.redwood/example/runbooks/deploy-issues
ajay: looking at canary pods — model-proxy-canary-2 CrashLoopBackOff. logs show secret load failure: 
```
Error: failed to load secret /etc/decoder/config: key 'decoder_key' not found
Caused by configmap patch from last deploy
```
ben (prod-eng): that aligns — the rollout included a configmap rewrite and a feature flag flip for decoder_v2. We targeted 10% via rollout. I think the configmap schema change didn't include the legacy key.
sre-liz: HPA also misread the new resource requests; saw HPA scale-to-zero during drain windows. HPA minReplicas dropped to 0 due to bad metric mapping.
maria (oncall): customer impact?
support-alex: multiple customers in us-west on canary buckets seeing 502/503 intermittently. ~12 support tickets, 30% request failures for some tenants. Triage team on it.
maria (oncall): ok immediate plan: 1) flip feature flag off for decoder_v2 (kill-switch) 2) pause rollout / scale canary to 0 3) rollback configmap if needed. Who can flip LD?
ben (prod-eng): I'm on LD — will flip now. Link: https://launchdarkly.com/flags/redwood/decoder_v2
ben (prod-eng): flipped decoder_v2 -> off :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: automatic traffic shift: canary traffic removed per feature-flag change. Observability: error rate down to 42% from 70% in last 30s.
ajay: still seeing CrashLoopBackOff on some pods, but new requests drop. Logs show pod start failing on missing key during init. Will scale canary to 0.
sre-liz: patching HPA to set minReplicas=2 to avoid scale-to-zero while we fix metrics. Command: `kubectl patch hpa model-proxy -n prod -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'`
maria (oncall): go ahead with patch. Also suspend the rollout: `kubectl rollout pause deployment/model-proxy -n prod`
ajay: paused. Scaling down canaries: `kubectl scale deployment model-proxy-canary --replicas=0 -n prod`
incident-bot: action log recorded. deploy pipeline link: https://ci.redwood.example/pipelines/1492 (rollback triggered)
ben (prod-eng): rolling back configmap to previous revision (rev 41) via CI. I also opened a quick PR to guard schema validation for missing keys.
support-alex: after flag flip and scale, error rate for /v1/generate now 6% in us-west (was 70). Some customers still report transient errors — informing affected tenants.
maria (oncall): good. calling for oncall handoff? I want SRE-liz to continue stabilization, I'll update incident page and loop in PM.
sre-liz: taking lead for stabilization. I'll monitor HPA, node conditions, and logs. Next steps: bake a schema validator in deploy pipeline, add HPA metric sanity check, and ensure feature flags are tied to config compatibility tests.
ben (prod-eng): postmortem items: tighten canary resource requests, add secret presence check to init container, add rollout guard to prevent configmap schema changes without prod-compat flag.
maria (oncall): incident severity -> Sev2 due to partial customer impact. Notifying customer ops.
incident-bot: page escalation to oncall-second at +5m if error rate > 10% persists.
sre-liz: will run a controlled redeploy once configmap rollback finishes and validators are in place. For now system stable.
maria (oncall): ramp down incident. creating follow-up meeting slot: 30m postmortem sync in #incidents-review. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
